en: Chinese President Xi Jinping has reaffirmed Beijing's commitment to strengthening ties with North Korea, saying the two countries have long supported each other across generations, the North's state media reported Thursday. Xi made the remarks in a reply sent to North Korean leader Kim Jong-un on Tuesday, responding to Kim's Oct. 1 congratulatory message marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of China, in which Kim pledged to further develop their traditional friendship and safeguard shared interests. Xi said the two countries are geographically connected and that their friendship and shared destiny have long been defining features of bilateral relations, according to the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). Xi also highlighted the outcome of his state visit to North Korea in June, saying the two leaders reached important common understandings on deepening bilateral ties and further strengthening strategic guidance for their development. "China is ready to work with North Korea to carry forward the traditional friendship between the two nations, consolidate mutual political trust, expand practical cooperation and maintain close communication and coordination," Xi said, according to the Korean-language dispatch by the KCNA, which did not carry an English version of the report. Relations between Pyongyang and Beijing faced strains in 2024 amid North Korea's deepening ties with Russia. But the two sides have moved to restore their longstanding ties following Kim's attendance at China's Victory Day military parade in 2025 and Xi's visit to North Korea this year. Exchanges and cooperation have also shown signs of expanding. Ambassador Yu Dunhai Meets Emir of Lafia Muhammad I

On October 20, 2026, Ambassador Yu Dunhai paid an official visit to Nasarawa State upon invitation, during which he met with the Emir of Lafia, Muhammad I.

Ambassador Yu commended His Royal Highness Emir Muhammad I for his commitment to advancing China-Nigeria friendship, noting that both China and Nigeria are ancient civilizations with shared cultural values. China attaches great importance to the unique role played by traditional leaders in Lafia in the development of bilateral relations and stands ready to work with Nigeria to strengthen local and people-to-people exchanges and cooperation, so as to contribute to the sustained high-quality development of China-Nigeria relations.

His Royal Highness Emir Muhammad I spoke positively of China’s development achievements and thanked China for its contributions to Nigeria’s economic and social development, especially that of Nasarawa State. He said that the Lafia Emirate Council is ready to continue to deepen practical cooperation and local exchanges with China, so that the fruits of cooperation can benefit the peoples of both countries.

His Royal Highness Emir Muhammad I held a Durbar traditional ceremony in honor of Ambassador Yu, and the atmosphere was warm and friendly. Ambassador Yu donated daily necessities to the Lafia community through the Lafia Emirate Council, which was warmly received by the local people.
